# `pagan.toml` settings

Every setting, its default and what changes when it changes. `pagan config show` lists the current values;
`pagan config set <key> <value>` edits the file safely (comments kept, the whole config validated first).

## Top level

| Setting | Default | Refreshes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `palette_mode` | `"strict"` | lint results only | "strict": assets use palette files only; "open": inline palettes allowed |
| `default_palette` | (none) | every asset (re-render models, recolour or re-check 2D art) | palette for assets that don't name one; switching it recolors all of them |
| `output_dir` | `"build"` | build output only | where `pagan build` writes final assets (e.g. a game engine's asset folder) |
| `preview_dir` | `"previews"` | nothing built | scratch folder for previews |
| `export` | `["png"]` | build output only | extra build outputs: "godot" (SpriteFrames/TileSet .tres), "normals" (normal maps for 3D models), "mesh" (3D models as .glb meshes for 3D games); "png" sheets + manifest are always written |
| `variant_sheets` | `true` | build output only | build a sheet (+ .tres) per variant; false: variants are only colour swap tables in manifest.json, for games that recolour in a shader |
| `supersample` | `1` | build output only | sources are drawn at N x the size the game gets; build box-filters them down to smooth, anti-aliased PNGs (for freely rotated, non-pixel-art sprites; 1 = off, pixel-exact) |
| `style_version` | `1` | lint results only | current style version; assets made under older ones get W006 (use `pagan style bump`) |

## `[camera]`

| Setting | Default | Refreshes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `camera.elevation` | `42.0` | 3D models re-render | 3D camera angle above the horizon in degrees: 90 = straight down, ~40 = top-down 3/4, ~15 = side-on |
| `camera.scale` | `1.0` | 3D models re-render | pixels per voxel for 3D models |
| `camera.projection` | `"orthographic"` | 3D models re-render | "orthographic": any elevation, camera.scale px per voxel; "dimetric": exact pixel 2:1 dimetric (tile, cell, z_step; elevation/scale unused), models use heading 45 + directions 4 |
| `camera.tile` | `[64, 32]` | 3D models re-render | dimetric: pixels per grid cell, [width, height] with width = 2 x height (the floor diamond, e.g. a 64x32 TileMap cell) |
| `camera.cell` | `16` | 3D models re-render | dimetric: voxels per grid cell side (a cell x cell floor is exactly one tile); must divide half the tile height |
| `camera.z_step` | `0` | 3D models re-render | dimetric: whole pixels per voxel of height (0 = tile height / cell, e.g. 2 for a 64x32 tile and cell 16) |

## `[light]`

| Setting | Default | Refreshes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `light.direction` | `[-0.5, 0.45, 0.75]` | 3D models re-render | direction towards the light: x right, y up the screen, z up (default: top-left) |
| `light.ambient` | `0.2` | 3D models re-render | brightness of unlit surfaces 0-1 (lower = darker shadows, more contrast) |
| `light.shadows` | `true` | 3D models re-render | parts cast shadows on each other |
| `light.shadow_strength` | `0.65` | 3D models re-render | how dark cast shadows are, 0-1 |
| `light.wrap` | `0.3` | 3D models re-render | how far light wraps around curves, 0-1 (higher = softer shading) |
| `light.baked` | `true` | 3D models re-render | true: shading baked into the pixels; false: flat colors for engines with their own lighting (add "normals" to export) |

## `[godot]`

| Setting | Default | Refreshes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `godot.mipmaps` | `false` | build output only | Godot imports the PNGs with mipmaps (for sprites drawn scaled down or rotated); written into each PNG's .import |
| `godot.filter` | `"inherit"` | build output only | SpriteFrames texture filter: "inherit" (node/project setting decides), "nearest" (crisp pixels), "linear" (smooth) |

## `[build]`

| Setting | Default | Refreshes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `build.trim` | `false` | build output only | sprites without their own `trim:` crop each frame to its content and pack the crops into the sheet (manifest frames gain trim_rect/offset; Godot AtlasTexture margin keeps the full frame size). Font and nine_slice sprites stay untrimmed |

## `[mesh]`

| Setting | Default | Refreshes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `mesh.voxel_size` | `0.0625` | mesh export (.glb) only | metres per voxel when 3D models export as meshes (0.0625 = 16 voxels per metre); pick it per game from the closest camera distance |
| `mesh.shading` | `"ramp"` | mesh export (.glb) only | "ramp": palette-locked lighting in the engine (PAGAN ramp shader); "baked": project light baked per face (no shader); "flat": middle ramp step, engine lights it |
| `mesh.collision_suffixes` | `false` | mesh export (.glb) only | name collision parts with Godot's -col/-convcol/-colonly suffixes (changes node names) |

## `[lint]`

| Setting | Default | Refreshes | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `lint.max_ramps_per_sprite` | `3` | lint results only | W003: most ramps one 2D sprite/tileset may use |
| `lint.max_ramps_per_model` | `6` | lint results only | W003: most ramps one 3D model may use (more materials: hull, sails, team colours) |
| `lint.max_frame_change` | `0.4` | lint results only | W007: share of pixels that may change between animation frames |
| `lint.max_ramp_steps` | `0` | lint results only | W008: most shades per ramp/material (0 = no limit) |
| `lint.disable` | `[]` | lint results only | warning ids to turn off |
| `lint.require_outline` | `false` | lint results only | E011: every sprite must use outline: auto |
| `lint.require_opaque` | `false` | lint results only | E015: sprites and tilesets may not use translucent ("#rrggbbaa") colours |
